#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 105;
long long sum[MAXN];
long long pw[MAXN];
bool ok = false;

void process(long long cur, long long target, int pos) {
    if (cur == target) {
        ok = true;
        return;
    }
    long long remaining = sum[pos + 1];
    long long next = pw[pos];
    if (cur - remaining > target) return;
    if (cur + remaining < target) return;
    if (cur + sum[pos] < target) {
        process(cur + next, target, pos - 1);
    } else if (cur - sum[pos] > target) {
        process(cur - next, target, pos - 1);
    } else {
        process(cur, target, pos - 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    long long p = 1;
    int mx = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < 100) {
        sum[i + 1] = p + sum[i];
        pw[i] = p;
        p *= w;
        if (p > (1LL << 40)) {
            mx = i;
            break;
        }
        i++;
    }

    process(0, m, mx);
    cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
